page.layout: One page, title page: a centred title block in roman and italic type, a woodcut ornament below the title, and the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Orationis formâ scriptus, ac habitus in Academiæ Marpurgen-
IN QUO DIVINATIO EX ASTRIS DEFENDI-
quæ in contrarium afferri solent, solidè & per-
Ex officina Pauli Egenolphi, Typogr. Academ.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the title and the imprint: a central cherub's head with fruit and foliage, swags and ribbons below; not transcribed. Handwritten marks (top left "Ytr. P. 163", top right "VVj", a "R" at left, "Ex" at lower left, "100" at foot) are manuscript annotations and are omitted. No page number, running head or signature is printed. The title is set in italic for the lines beginning "CONTRA" and "Orationis", and in italic for "Lege, & dextrè judica." The "q;" in "objectionesq;," is a printed abbreviation with a mark over the q.
